issues.current_text: O CEO da Anthropic, Dario Amodei, reuniu-se na sexta com a chefe de gabinete da Casa Branca, Susie Wiles, e o secretário do Tesouro, Scott Bessent, para discutir o impasse.
issues.previous_text: o CEO Dario Amodei se reuniu na Casa Branca com a chefe de gabinete Susie Wiles e o secretário do Tesouro Scott Bessent para negociar acesso de outros órgãos ao Mythos
issues.suggestion: This is the same meeting covered two days ago. The April 18 edition already reported it in detail. Either cut the sentence entirely and let the NSA angle carry the section, or — if there's genuinely new information from the Friday meeting — state explicitly what changed since the 18th. Don't re-report the meeting as if it's new.

issues.current_text: fabricantes atendem apenas cerca de 60% da demanda global por chips de memória, engolida pela expansão dos data centers de IA
issues.previous_text: A produção global de DRAM [...] deve atender apenas 60% da demanda até o fim de 2027 [...] Fabricantes precisariam expandir a produção em 12% ao ano para acompanhar, mas crescem 7,5%.
issues.suggestion: The 60% figure was the centerpiece of yesterday's 'Memória & custos' section with full context (Nikkei data, expansion rates, smartphone impact). Today it reappears as an aside explaining Apple delays. Either drop the stat and just say 'escassez global de chips de memória' or reference yesterday's coverage: 'a escassez de memória que detalhamos ontem'. Don't re-present stale data as fresh context.

issues.current_text: A prefeita Katie Wilson anunciou que estuda uma moratória na construção de novos data centers [...] 54 mil cartas de moradores contra projetos que consumiriam um terço da eletricidade diária da cidade.
issues.previous_text: Maine aprovou a primeira moratória estadual do país para data centers acima de 20 megawatts, válida até outubro de 2027, e pelo menos onze outros estados estudam restrições semelhantes
issues.suggestion: Seattle is a new city, but the narrative — local resistance → moratória on data centers — ran yesterday with Maine. Frame as escalation: 'Depois de Maine aprovar a primeira moratória estadual na sexta, Seattle estuda seguir o mesmo caminho' to show the trend accelerating rather than telling the same story with a different proper noun.

issues.current_text: O destróier USS Spruance disparou contra e apreendeu o navio iraniano Touska no Golfo de Omã [...] O Irã chamou o ato de pirataria, respondeu com drones e abandonou negociações no Paquistão; o cessar-fogo de duas semanas expira nos próximos dias. O petróleo Brent subiu 5,3%, a US$95,62 o barril.
issues.previous_text: O petróleo saltou de US$90 para US$100 o barril em 48 horas [...] O Irã mantém o fechamento do estreito [...] Trump classificou o episódio como 'violação grave' do cessar-fogo, que expira na quarta-feira
issues.suggestion: The ship seizure is genuinely new, but the section re-explains the ceasefire countdown and oil price swing that ran in both April 18 and April 19. The reader has gotten three consecutive days of Hormuz-oil-ceasefire. Lead with the USS Spruance seizure (the news), state the oil price in one clause, and cut the ceasefire explainer — anyone following the newsletter already knows.

issues.current_text: a chefe de gabinete da Casa Branca, Susie Wiles, e o secretário do Tesouro, Scott Bessent
issues.previous_text: a chefe de gabinete Susie Wiles e o secretário do Tesouro Scott Bessent
issues.suggestion: Same pair, nearly identical phrasing. Since they were introduced two days ago, use just last names: 'Wiles e Bessent' — or a compact reference like 'os mesmos interlocutores da Casa Branca da semana passada'.

issues.current_text: fabricantes atendem apenas cerca de 60% da demanda global por chips de memória
issues.previous_text: deve atender apenas 60% da demanda até o fim de 2027
issues.suggestion: Near-identical sentence structure with the same number. If you keep the stat, at minimum vary the construction: 'a oferta de memória cobre pouco mais da metade da demanda' or just link to the shortage without re-quoting the figure.

issues.current_text: Geopolítica section: Ormuz → oil price → ceasefire deadline → Russia/Ukraine → Pacific exercises
issues.previous_text: Geopolítica section: Ormuz → oil price → ceasefire deadline → Russia sanctions → Israel/Lebanon ceasefire (April 19, 18, 17 all lead with Ormuz/Iran)
issues.suggestion: Four consecutive editions open Geopolítica with Hormuz/Iran/oil. The structure is: Iran does X → oil moves Y% → ceasefire update. Readers may feel stuck in a loop. Consider leading with Balikatan exercises or Ukraine bombardment and folding the Ormuz update into a shorter item, since the ship seizure is the only net-new development.

issues.current_text: SK hynix iniciou a produção em massa do SOCAMM2 de 192 GB, módulo projetado para o acelerador Vera Rubin da Nvidia
issues.previous_text: A SK Hynix [...] vai usar o processo de 3 nanômetros da TSMC na base da HBM4E, próxima geração da memória empilhada que abastece os aceleradores de IA da Nvidia
issues.suggestion: SK Hynix + Nvidia memory pairing appeared yesterday (HBM4E for Nvidia) and today (SOCAMM2 for Vera Rubin). Both are valid stories but the framing is identical: SK Hynix builds next-gen memory for Nvidia's next chip. Acknowledge continuity: 'Depois de fechar parceria com a TSMC para a HBM4E, a SK Hynix agora entrega...' — or fold into Intel as the lead for semiconductors and make SK Hynix a subordinate clause.

summary: Moderate-to-high repetition. The Amodei-Wiles-Bessent meeting is a direct repeat from April 18. The 60% memory stat and Hormuz/ceasefire cycle are running for the third and fourth day respectively — both need reframing or cutting. SK Hynix-for-Nvidia and data center moratória narratives feel like reruns with different nouns.
